The following three performance rates are reported across four age groups (18 to 64, 65 to 74, 75 to 84, and 85 and older). *Short-Term Stay:* The rate of admissions resulting in a short-term stay (1 to 20 days) per 1,000 Medicaid LTSS participant months. *Medium-Term Stay:* The rate of admissions resulting in a medium-term stay (21 to 100 days) per 1,000 Medicaid LTSS participant months. *Long-Term Stay:* The rate of admissions resulting in a long-term stay (greater than or equal to 101 days) per 1,000 Medicaid LTSS participant months. *Denominator:* Number of participant months where the participant was residing in the community for at least one day of the month. 00968–01–C–LTSS CMS .....................
